verdict.line: You lose if you tunnel into Hallowed Mist and eat free Snip Snip! stacks; you win if you all-in while her W and E are both down and close with Demacian Justice before A Thousand Cuts heals her back.

brief.thesis: Gwen's whole lane plan is to poke with Q (Snip Snip!) and E (Skip 'n Slash) while using W (Hallowed Mist) to wall off retaliation, but she has no hard CC and no way to stop Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) silence from cutting her W cast mid-trade. At 1,962 games Garen sits at 51% with the lane and solo-kill edge, which matches an aggressive shape where you force fights on your terms rather than trading passively into her on-hit procs.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Skip 'n Slash) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can dash in, get a few seconds of bonus attack speed/range/magic on-hit, and dash back out, refunding the cooldown if she connects. Don't chase into this window — wait her E out before committing.

yourWindow.when: Both her W and E are on cooldown
yourWindow.what: She has no disengage (E) and no damage shield (W) — walk her down immediately. Lead with Q (Decisive Strike) for the silence so she physically cannot cast Hallowed Mist mid-fight, then W (Courage) and E (Judgment) to stack AoE damage.

powerCurve.note: No Hallowed Mist yet, trades are even-or-better
Demacian Justice threatens execute, forces respect
Her Q cooldown shrinks, Conqueror sustain matches it
Mortal Reminder cuts her passive healing hard

start.why: Paired with Health Potion, it's the 66.7% win sample over 9 games — the flat damage reduction eats into her Q cone ticks and E on-hit autos so her poke doesn't add up.

boots.why: 78.3% pick, 50% win rate over 18 games — attack speed keeps your E (Judgment) spin ticking and your autos landing between her E dash windows.

core.why: The slow on-hit lets you actually stick to her when her E (Skip 'n Slash) is down, which is when you're supposed to be all-inning.
Active haste closes the gap before she can cycle W (Hallowed Mist) back up.
Grievous Wounds directly answers A Thousand Cuts — her passive heal is the only thing letting her survive your all-in windows.

situational.when: she's building tanky and you need sustained attack speed instead of burst
you're landing every cooldown rotation and want faster ability uptime
you need to close the distance before her E refund window resets
the game has gone long and you need raw damage to punch through her on-hit magic stacking

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are the goal here — her E dash poke doesn't one-shot you, so stacking Conqueror through repeated short trades builds the healing that outlasts her passive sustain.

summoners.why: Run at 56.5% of games and 100% pick rate here — Ignite is the counter to A Thousand Cuts, since it denies the healing tick right as you commit Demacian Justice.

playing.title: Trade before level 3
playing.detail: Gwen has no Hallowed Mist until she levels W, so levels 1-2 are your cleanest window to poke with W (Courage) and walk away before she can answer.

playing.title: Save Q for her W cast
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence stops her from casting Hallowed Mist mid-fight — land the attack the instant she tries to wall off, not before.

playing.title: Don't chase into her E window
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash gives her a few seconds of bonus attack speed, range, and magic on-hit after the dash — trading into that window just feeds her cooldown refund.

playing.title: All-in when both cooldowns are down
playing.detail: With W (22-18s) and E (13-11s) both spent, she has zero disengage — this is when Garen's raw stat check wins outright.

playing.title: Hold Ignite for the execute
playing.detail: Pair Ignite with Demacian Justice rather than using it early — the grievous wounds tick is what stops her passive healing from undoing your ult.

playing.title: Rush Mortal Reminder if she's healing through everything
playing.detail: If A Thousand Cuts is keeping her alive in extended trades by mid-game, prioritize Mortal Reminder over Youmuu's to shut that down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner picks above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the matchup reasoning — silence timing, W/E cooldown windows, and the grievous-wounds counter — is my own read of the ability kits, not sourced data.
